theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the cleanest trend-eligible, non-crowded, scorable challenger. It ranks #2, is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, has the strongest trend signature (hurst_tag 'trend', durability_bar 0.71), healthy breadth 0.857, and is NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.44). Unlike Oil & Gas (crowded=true, z=1.18), this theme offers trend participation without crowding caution. The gate_helps=true record supports staying with eligible trend names.
evidence: hurst_tag 'trend' and durability_bar 0.71 (highest among eligible leaders)
theses.dissent: Banks are rate-sensitive and lag energy leadership; if the macro rotation narrows into a one-narrative oil/gas tape, banks could underperform despite clean trend structure.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The dominant theme, eligible and with the highest score and strong breadth (0.929), but crowded=true (z=1.18) triggers the guardrail: size-down caution, never a fade. Durability_bar 0.69 with hurst 'mixed' notes less clean trend texture than banks. Lean is overweight only in the direction sense, with crowding as a reason to be deliberately restrained — not to chase.
theses.dissent: The crowding flag and 'mixed' hurst signal the leadership may be late-cycle; energy is reflexivity-prone and attention spikes mark tops, so chasing the dominant theme invites a shake-out that the trend gate exists to avoid.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO goes flat while ZEB.TO gains more than 4% over the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is eligible but crowded=true (z=1.35, the highest crowding in the table) with a negative score (-0.03) and 'trend' hurst. Eligibility keeps it in the trend universe, but the combination of negative momentum and the most extended crowding in the set makes a lean of avoidance more honest than even a constructive underweight. This is a direction, not a short.
theses.dissent: Trend persistence can reward staying with crowded winners; the 'trend' hurst and broad 0.8 breadth mean tech may simply grind sideways rather than break down, making an active underweight premature.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms XEG.TO by more than 5% before 15 trading days pass
